title: First successful dishwasher patented
summary: Josephine Cochrane invented and manufactured the first successful hand-powered dishwasher, patented on 28 December 1886.
why: Ancestor of a now-everyday household machine.

unsung.contribution: Invented and manufactured the first successful hand-powered dishwasher.
unsung.recognition: She faced many obstacles as a woman inventor; she entered the National Inventors Hall of Fame only posthumously, in 2006.
